item.title: KRShNa thief
item.description:
नारायणो नाम नरो नराणां
प्रसिद्धचोरः कथितः पृथिव्याम्।
अनेक-जन्मार्जित-पाप-सञ्चयं
हरत्य् अशेषं स्मृतमात्र एव ।।

This is poem was
composed by Shriman madhvacharya.
One of the most beautiful poems of “Sri Krishnamrita maharmava ”.
the meaning of this sloka,

“Lord Sri Krishna is the most biggest thief in the world .he is not an only simple thief
He is the biggest one.”

Hey wait wait !
What are we saying?
Is this true?
